text:
maria: Heads-up 10am data check 1: registration >> attendance gap on the product webinar. dashboard shows +58% regs MoM but attendance rate down to 12%. https://app.redwood.com/dash/webinar-performance
tony: that's a big drop. did we change the confirmation flow or email series?
neha: we swapped the confirmation CTA copy on the landing page last week and enabled the quick-register JS widget for mobile only. could be mobile friction or a double-counting bug. :iphone:
analytics-bot: [auto] Anomaly detected: registration-to-attend conversion below historical baseline (p95). Cohort: last 7 days.
ops: I pulled the raw event log. 40% of recent registrants have no confirm_email event in the stream. suspect client-side race condition on the JS widget.
maria: can you paste a tiny sample of the event rows?
ops: sample (CSV):
"id,created_at,event,platform,utm_source,confirm_email"
"a1,3141589001,register,mobile,newsletter,false"
"a2,3141589015,register,desktop,search,true"
"a3,3141589020,register,mobile,cpc,false"
"a4,3141589055,register,mobile,newsletter,false"
"..."
tony: ok that explains the attendance delta. mobile quick-register sometimes skips sending the confirm_email event. tracking mismatch -> inflated regs.
neha: we need to adjust the weekly KPI dashboard to include a "confirmed registration" metric and a mobile/desktop breakdown. bench narrative should call this out under quality vs. quantity.
maria: agree. add a slide to Monday's KPI review: baseline (historical confirmed rate), current dip, root cause hypothesis, and short-term mitigation.
ops: short-term fix: revert to previous CTA on mobile and force confirm_email at submit. i'll stage a patch now and post status.
tony: also recommend a watchlist for cohorts where confirmed_rate < 60% to avoid misleading CAC math in the growth deck.
neha: taking dashboard task. will add the confirmed metric, device filter, and an annotation that points to the patch change timestamp.
maria: action items: (1) ops deploy patch (ops) (2) dashboard update + annotation (neha) (3) update benchmark slide + talking points (maria/tony) (4) callout in weekly KPI email (maria). meeting in 15 to sync on wording. :spiral_calendar:
analytics-bot: [reminder] Weekly KPI review: Mon 9:00am PT. This thread will be linked in the agenda.
